$comment: 3.0 performance budget from the Tau performance audit (budget table, D12, D16). Blocking rows compare exactly; a referenceOnly row blocks only on the reference GPU (GIZMO_GPU=metal) and is reported elsewhere (CI SwiftShader measured 1.2 to 1.6 kB per animating frame where Metal measures 0.5 to 0.8 kB); report rows print and alarm at 3x the 2.3.0 reference (reference machine only). A row with an owner is an expected failure against 2.3.0 until that task flips it: set expectedFail to false in the owner's pull request. checkedBy names the gate that measures the row; a test-browser row lists the browser-gate test titles that check it (tests, a pattern), and perf/check.mjs reports their results from perf/out/browser.json.
reference: Apple M2 Pro, Chromium 156 headless, ANGLE Metal and WebGPU apple metal-3, 800x600 canvas, DPR 1, 128 px gizmo; 2.3.0 figures in perf/baseline-2.3.0.json
